negative_findings.description: Plain WebFetch of https://bank.gov.ua/ua/legislation returned HTTP 403 Forbidden. The site is clearly live (indexed, PDFs served from the same host appear in results), so this reads as WAF/bot filtering rather than a dead endpoint.
negative_findings.result_summary: 403 on the single most important URL in this cell; static /admin_uploads PDFs on the same host were returned by search normally.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The origin node for every Ukrainian banking prudential deadline cannot be harvested with a naive HTTP client; collection design must assume a browser-context fetcher plus the zakon.rada.gov.ua mirror as fallback. Recorded as UNVERIFIED, not dead.

negative_findings.description: No confirmed RSS/Atom feed URL for the NBU news or legislation sections was located within this run; search returned the HTML listing (bank.gov.ua/en/news/all) and open-data API docs but no feed endpoint.
negative_findings.result_summary: RSS existence neither confirmed nor disproved.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If no feed exists, near-real-time deadline detection requires polling and diffing HTML, which raises the cost and fragility of the collector for the highest-priority source.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated, machine-readable NBU register of effective dates / transition deadlines (a 'календар набрання чинності') was found. Effective-date information appears only inside the operative clauses of each act and in news items.
negative_findings.result_summary: Deadlines must be extracted from free text ('ця постанова набирає чинності з ...'), not read from a structured field.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The A3 deadline workstream will need NLP/regex extraction over act texts rather than a lookup, and cross-validation against zakon.rada document metadata.

negative_findings.description: Official NBU English versions of resolutions appear partial; English content found was either NBU summary pages or third-party translations (cis-legislation.com) of uncertain currency.
negative_findings.result_summary: English coverage is derivative; Ukrainian is the only authoritative language for this cell.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any English-only pipeline would silently miss or misdate binding requirements; uk parsing is mandatory.

negative_findings.description: LIGA:ZAKON (ips.ligazakon.net) serves NBU resolution texts but behind session tokens/paywall; the search-surfaced URLs carry rnd/session parameters indicating non-stable, non-scrapable access.
negative_findings.result_summary: Rich amendment-chain data exists but is not lawfully or technically bulk-collectable without a licence.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Amendment-chain tracking (which resolution changed which) may need a paid subscription or must be reconstructed from zakon.rada redaction history.

coverage_gaps.description: The internal URL/filter structure of bank.gov.ua/ua/legislation (act-type filters, date filters, pagination, per-act permalink pattern) could not be enumerated because the page 403'd.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Re-attempt with a headless browser session (claude-in-chrome / Playwright) and map the filter query-string schema before designing the collector.

coverage_gaps.description: Non-bank / payment-service-provider normative base was only identified via an NBU news announcement; the actual section URL and its taxonomy were not confirmed. Given sector=both this is a material hole.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Follow the announcement item to the dedicated non-bank normative section and register it as a first-class source with its own crawl.

coverage_gaps.description: Adjacent Ukrainian actors that shape or mirror NBU prudential deadlines were not explored in this cell (Ministry of Justice act-registration register, Deposit Guarantee Fund, Verkhovna Rada finance committee, EU-approximation reporting). Some sit outside this cell by design but the boundary should be explicit.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Confirm with the orchestrator which of these belong to other A3 cells; if unowned, add the Мін'юст state registration register as a date-authority source.

coverage_gaps.description: Historical depth was not tested: whether bank.gov.ua exposes pre-2019 acts or whether zakon.rada's 4,176-document NBU set is complete back to 1991 was not verified document-by-document.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Sample-compare a few years (e.g. 2008, 2015) across bank.gov.ua, zakon.rada and old.bank.gov.ua to quantify completeness before relying on any single mirror for history.

coverage_gaps.description: Russian-language mirrors of NBU acts exist on zakon.rada (uk-ru paths) but were not assessed; run languages are uk/en so this is deliberate, though ru mirrors sometimes have different availability.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Note as out-of-scope unless the orchestrator extends languages; do not build ru parsing.

brief: The National Bank of Ukraine is a single-origin publisher: every binding prudential requirement for banks and, since the 'split', for payment and non-bank financial service providers, appears first as a numbered постанова Правління on bank.gov.ua, whose website placement is itself a statutory form of official publication alongside Офіційний вісник України. The practical landscape is therefore one authoritative but bot-defended primary site (a plain fetch of the legislation section returned 403 — treat as WAF-blocked, not dead), one fully fetchable state mirror at zakon.rada.gov.ua carrying roughly 4,176 NBU resolutions from 1991 to 2026 with consolidated texts and status flags, and a thin layer of consultation, association and media sources that surface deadlines earlier or explain them. The critical structural weakness for the A3 deadline workstream is that no machine-readable register of effective dates or transition periods exists: dates live inside the operative clause of each act, so extraction must be text-based and cross-validated between the NBU site, the Rada mirror and the NBU news announcement of the same resolution. Ukrainian is the only authoritative language here; English material is derivative and should never be used to fix a date.
